# Lagoon — inspiration only

Clinics. Motion personality: fluid. Spring, morph, blob, gooey radius. No other theme may use this motion.

## Look at

- Fluid Glass, Exo Ape, Awwwards SOTD. Translucent panels used because the product is glass. We take the idea of a surface that changes shape, not their layout. https://www.awwwards.com/sites/fluid-glass
- Apple Liquid Glass commentary, 2026. Depth as hierarchy. We do not copy the system font, the toolbar, or the blur stack. https://elements.envato.com/learn/web-design-trends
- RLVNT Studios, Orpetron, February 2026. Liquid glass in chrome. We keep glass off scrolling content. https://orpetron.com/sites/the-rlvnt-studios-new-ui-design/
- fromanother / FWA-style light refraction, described in 2026 WebGL roundups. Identity as a moving field. Ours is a few transformed blobs, not their shader.

## We will write

Abyss ground, bioluminescent cyan, a magenta bloom. Controls change border-radius and scale. The hero is two or three blobs on transforms. Text sits on an opaque surface.

## We will not write

Their markup, their shaders, a page-wide `backdrop-filter`, or a purple gradient button.
